small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 58%: the inner ic loop creates a 72-reg footprint. Move ic to the innermost vectorized axis (e.g. add BLOCK_IC=16 and use tl.dot on a [BLOCK_OC,BLOCK_IC]x[BLOCK_IC,BLOCK_SPATIAL] tile) so the compiler emits MMA instead of scalar FMAs. Add autotune configs with BLOCK_OC=32,BLOCK_SPATIAL=32,BLOCK_IC=16,num_warps=4 and BLOCK_OC=64,BLOCK_SPATIAL=32,BLOCK_IC=16,num_warps=8. Also fuse the BN affine (folded scale/shift from running stats) and the bias into the conv epilogue to eliminate the separate cudnn BN launch.
large_guidance: Rewrite as a gather-based GEMM: for each output tile (N, OC-tile, OD*OH*OW-tile), build the implicit im2col of the transposed-conv input (K = IC*KD*KH*KW) and call tl.dot with BLOCK_M=32/64 (OC), BLOCK_N=64/128 (spatial), BLOCK_K=32. Precompute kd/kh/kw decomposition tables and the (od+PD-kd) divisibility/index masks once outside the K loop. Fold BatchNorm (eval-time scale=gamma/sqrt(var+eps), shift=beta-scale*mean — but BN runs in train mode here; instead compute per-channel mean/var of conv_out in a second small kernel, then fuse normalize+spatial-mean-subtract into one elementwise pass) so only two kernels remain: GEMM-conv and a fused BN+mean-sub epilogue. Use channels_last-style output layout so the spatial dim is contiguous for both the GEMM store and the BN reductions.
